detail.name: S1 On Call Savings
detail.description: An everyday transaction account that gives you easy access to your money.

features.additionalInfo: Pay your bills from the comfort of your home.
A Visa Debit card gives you access to your money in branch, at an ATM, in stores and online.
Do your banking online anytime, anywhere using our Internet Banking or Mobile Banking App.
Load your FSCU Visa Debit card to your mobile deivce to make fast and easy transactions.
New Payment Platform (NPP)  Transact instantly with real-time payments.
PayID - and easily remembered identifier such as email, mobile or ABN linked to your accout at FSCU.
A personal overdraft facility available at a great low rate.
No account keeping fees, no monthly fees.
